snippet.title: Goliath Rogue
snippet.description:
Auto-casting heroes against scaling hordes — with real itemization, a talent web
per skill, and a town that grows from whatever you drag home.

▶ Play free in your browser: https://goliathe.itch.io/goliath-rogue

Goliath Rogue is a vampire-survivors-like with ARPG teeth. Your heroes cast on
their own. You move, you position, you choose what to pick up — everything else
is the build you assembled on the way down.
Where most survivors-likes end at the run, this one keeps going.

WHAT'S IN IT

• 13 heroes on genuinely different resources — the barbarian runs on rage, the
  samurai on focus, the necromancer commands minions
• 19 biomes on an atlas route-map, from the Catacombs to the Astral Rift and the
  Forgotten Library — floor mods accumulate across a run
• 15 biome bosses, plus the recurring Bone Serpent that unlocks your talent trees
  and comes back longer and meaner — and SUPER SKELETER, the megaboss at floor 20
• 72 enemy types, each with its own attack: webs that slow your movement AND your
  casting, telegraphed slams, exploding rats, poison spits
• Real itemization — two prefixes, two suffixes, typed damage and resists, item
  level scaling per floor, and a forge where 16 materials infuse mods of their own
  family into empty slots
• 52 skills, each with its own talent web, where notables change BEHAVIOUR —
  bouncing, splitting, homing, cascades — not just numbers
• A town that remembers: villagers you rescue settle in, buy roofs, and work while
  you are away
Death keeps your gear and your materials. Levels go. That's the arrangement.
Free. Plays in your browser, or download for Windows and Linux.

▶ https://goliathe.itch.io/goliath-rogue

Built in Godot 4.7. Some assets were produced with the help of generative AI
tools; game design, code and systems are my own work.
#roguelite #indiegame #bullethell #godot #survivorslike
